observations: Pitch is measured from your recording; gaps have no reliable voiced pitch.
Expected shapes use conservative surface-tone rules; dictionary tones stay separate.

limitations: Praat reduces but cannot eliminate octave errors or creaky-voice ambiguity.
The original tracker frequency remains stored alongside the energy-gated F0.
Filtered-track disagreement flags ambiguous evidence; it never substitutes a pitch.
Utterance-relative pitch is not a lexical-tone or intended-target correctness score.
